Harness"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"WorkBuddy"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"iTerm2"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Safari"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Chrome"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"WeChat"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Feishu"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Most of vibe coding is not typing. You read a reply, flip between chats, change the model, say a sen"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"tence, and wait. One hand is enough for all of that. VibeWand puts it on a dial or a controller so y"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ou can lean back while you work."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The tools keep multiplying, and each has its own chat list, model menu and shortcuts. VibeWand repla"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ces none of them. It puts them behind one set of motions: the same dial reads, the same button liste"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ns and the same press switches in every app, and the work is still done by the software you chose. W"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"hat is unified is the way in, not the features. That is what "One wand to command them all" means."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Read.** Turn the dial or push a stick to scroll the conversation. Once the draft has text in it,"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" the same motion moves the cursor instead.
- **Speak.** Hold the microphone button and talk. When yo"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"u let go, the text is in the composer, and nothing is sent for you. Use the built-in recognition, wh"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ich records from the microphone of the device you are holding: macOS dictation or your own speech AP"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"I, both of which take your own vocabulary, or SenseVoice running on this Mac with no key and no netw"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ork. Or keep using an input method such as Typeless. With vocabulary learning on (it is off by defau"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"lt), the words you correct in the field afterwards go into your vocabulary.
- **Switch.** Press once"},{"id":"p18s8","text":" for the chat list, turn to choose, press to confirm. Long-press for reasoning effort and models. Do"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"uble-press to switch macOS apps.
- **Remap.** Every button's press, double press and long press can "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"be reassigned in Settings, and each device keeps its own layout.
- **Command.** Hold the command key"},{"id":"p18s11","text":" and say “switch to the Codex chat about the microphone” or “open the Runtime.swift tab”, and it fin"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"ds and opens it for you; “set the effort to the lowest” works the menu that Codex's model button ope"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"ns. With Alibaba's voice service, its model hears the command itself, acts, and answers you aloud; t"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"he voice is yours to pick, a man's, a woman's or a dialect, and “switch to a man's voice” does it to"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"o. A command you spoke can be played back as you said it. The model is yours to choose: DeepSeek, Op"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"enAI, Anthropic, a local model or any compatible address. It works as soon as one is set up, and can"},{"id":"p18s17","text":" instead run as a plugin of a DeepSeek Harness you installed yourself, where each conversation can b"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"e read and models are set up; see Command mode."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"*Actual VibeWand 0.11.2 window, captured in Demo mode.*"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A floating overlay shows what each button will do right now. It collapses into a thin bar when you w"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ant it out of the way, and the button that expands and collapses it never moves."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Devices"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Type | Connection | Tested with |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| **VibeKey**

| **Controller**

| **Keyboard** | No device needed: six key combinations stand for t"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"he buttons, and any key, a custom keyboard's extra keys included, is recorded by pressing it | Key e"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"vents posted into a test window; a physical custom keyboard has not been tried |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Several devices can stay connected at once. Press a button on one and the overlay and button layout "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"follow it; there is nothing to switch in Settings. VibeWand has no server and needs no account. With a"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"n external input method it only holds Fn for you. With built-in recognition, audio stays in memory; "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"macOS dictation runs on device when it can, SenseVoice always does, and API mode sends audio to the "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"endpoint you entered. Keys live in the macOS Keychain and are never part of an exported configuratio"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"n. Dictated text goes into the field and no further; sending it is up to you. With vocabulary learni"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ng on (off by default), the dictations you corrected are kept on this Mac until the vocabulary is ne"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"xt brought up to date, sent then to the model service of command mode, and deleted. A terminal has n"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"o composer control, so VibeWand reads the few rows next to the cursor to find the prompt; they are r"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"educed to a state in memory and dropped, never stored or sent anywhere."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Command mode is on by default, and until you set up a model it does nothing and contacts no service."},{"id":"p31s2","text":" After that, the words of your commands, the titles of apps and chats, and the labels of controls in"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" the front window while the interface is operated are sent to the model service you chose yourself. "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"The contents of fields and documents are not, unless you turn on seeing the window, which sends the "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"model a picture of the window as it is and the text read in it. When Voice input uses Alibaba Qwen R"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"ealtime, its model hears commands itself by default, and all of this goes to that voice service toge"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"ther with the recording of the command; with several models instead, the voice service is sent only "},{"id":"p31s8","text":"the line that is to be read out. What each command did is recorded on this Mac, a spoken command wit"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"h its recording (which can be turned off), and deleted after 14 days.
